recent_posts.title: Redesigning DjangoProject.com
recent_posts.summary: The Django News Newsletter covers several topics: djangoproject.com is undergoing a redesign with community involvement; a new DEP 20 proposes an annual Django release cycle; pip 26.1 introduces lockfiles and dependency cooldowns; Carlton Gibson argues for running Django's main branch in production; pgBackRest's sole maintainer has stepped away, raising open source sustainability concerns; and Django 6.1 will include a new ModelAdmin.delete_confirmation_max_display option and improved blank choice labels in forms. Events include DjangoCon US in Chicago (Aug 24-28), EuroPython 2026 in Krakow, and Django Day Copenhagen.

recent_posts.title: Issue 334: New look, new home, same everything else
recent_posts.summary: Django News Issue 334 covers Read the Docs adding native uv support for faster Python dependency installs, a JetBrains/DSF PyCharm discount promotion, DSF member spotlight on Rob Hudson (creator of Django Debug Toolbar), PSF Q1 2026 Fellows announcement, and a recap of DjangoCon Europe 2026. Django core updates include new BitAnd/BitOr/BitXor aggregates moved from contrib.postgres to core, a File class boolean context fix, and a template bug fix. Articles cover safely updating dependencies, Django memory issues with Python 3.14's incremental GC, and PDM as an alternative to uv. Upcoming events include Django on the Med sprints and PyBeach 2026.

recent_posts.title: Django News issue 333 covering governance, fundraiser, and community updates
recent_posts.summary: Django News Issue 333 covers the annual JetBrains/DSF PyCharm fundraiser (30% off, all proceeds to Django), a proposed new technical governance model seeking community feedback, Django's adoption of Contributor Covenant 3.0, and Python's decision to revert the incremental GC in 3.14/3.15. Also included: Django Fellow reports, articles on enforcing business logic at the database layer and decoupling it from the ORM, a pattern combining django-tables2/django-filter/HTMX, the approval of PEP 772 (Python Packaging Council), Łukasz Langa's five-year retrospective as CPython Developer in Residence, and a discussion on why coding agents still recommend pip over uv.

recent_posts.title: Django news issue 333 covering PyCharm fundraiser, governance updates, and community articles
recent_posts.summary: Issue 333 of the Django News newsletter covers the annual PyCharm + Django fundraiser offering 30% off PyCharm Pro with proceeds supporting Django's core development. Key highlights include Django adopting Contributor Covenant 3.0, a new technical governance proposal open for community feedback, and a call for DjangoCon Europe 2027 organizers. Python news includes the rollback of the incremental garbage collector in 3.14/3.15 and approval of PEP 772 creating a Python Packaging Council. Articles cover enforcing business logic at the database layer using transactions and constraints, decoupling business logic from the Django ORM, and combining django-tables2, django-filter, and HTMX. Also featured: Django Tasks podcast episode 200 on django.tasks in Django 6.0, Carlton Gibson on incremental typing, and several new Django-related open source projects.

recent_posts.title: DjangoCon Europe Next Week!
recent_posts.summary: Django News Issue #332 covers Django security releases (6.0.4, 5.2.13, 4.2.30) fixing five CVEs, with Django 4.2 reaching end of extended support. DjangoCon Europe is happening April 15-19 in Athens. Notable Django codebase updates include stable queryset ordering fixes and async login/logout middleware fixes. Also featured: a Claude Code plugin for triaging Django issues, a guide on switching Python packages to PyPI trusted publishing, upcoming events like Django Day Copenhagen and PyOhio 2026, and a new django-root-secret package for runtime secret management.

recent_posts.title: Django newsletter covering supply chain attacks, Python tooling and community updates
recent_posts.summary: This Django newsletter covers a supply chain attack on PyPI packages highlighting the need for dependency locking, the PyCon US 2026 schedule going live, DSF board updates, and Wagtail CMS tutorials. Articles include Python's lazy imports journey from PEP 690 rejection to PEP 810 acceptance, AI code review pitfalls with database indexes, Django ORM performance improvements by removing redundant indexes, SHA pinning limitations in GitHub Actions, and OpenAI's acquisition of Astral (makers of uv). Community events include DjangoCon Europe in Athens and DjangoCon US in Chicago.

recent_posts.title: Balancing the AI Flood in Django
recent_posts.summary: A curated Django newsletter covering LLM integration patterns, Django 6.1 updates (including ORM alias quoting, mail function changes, and streaming response improvements), supply chain security research, AI-generated PR problems in open source, and community news from Djangonaut Space. Also includes articles on Python library modernization, pylock.toml attestations, and debates around AI-generated content in Django documentation.

recent_posts.title: Sunsetting Jazzband
recent_posts.summary: The Django News newsletter covers Jazzband winding down after 10+ years maintaining 80+ Python projects, citing AI-generated spam and sustainability challenges. Astral (creators of Ruff and uv) is joining OpenAI's Codex team. Other highlights include Django updates deprecating the undocumented get_placeholder method, articles on Python supply chain security, typing Django projects in 2026, Python 3.15's JIT progress, and community discussion on open source funding models following the Astral acquisition.

recent_posts.title: Django newsletter issue 328 with core PRs, security releases and community updates
recent_posts.summary: Django newsletter covering the week of March 13, 2026. Highlights include 21 PRs merged into Django core by 11 contributors (including 2 first-timers), Django security releases (6.0.3, 5.2.12, 4.2.29), and a note from Django Fellow Natalia about the growing noise from LLM-generated pull requests. Also covered: DjangoCon US 2026 CFP extended to March 23, Python 3.15.0 alpha 7 with lazy imports and frozendict, a proposal for AddConstraintConcurrently in contrib.postgres, tips on avoiding empty strings in non-nullable model fields, and a practical comparison of Meilisearch vs Elasticsearch showing cost reduction from $120 to $14/month.

recent_posts.title: Django Security Fixes, Python Releases, and New Tools
recent_posts.summary: Django 6.0.3, 5.2.12, and 4.2.29 were released to fix URLField DoS on Windows and file permission race conditions. Python 3.12.13, 3.11.15, and 3.10.20 also landed with security and DoS fixes across email, HTTP, XML, and SSL. Other highlights include PEP 827 proposing type manipulation APIs for ORMs and decorators, Wagtail's GSoC 2026 projects and 6-month roadmap, Djangonaut Space Session 6 team introductions, articles on case-insensitive unique constraints, PostgreSQL row lock edge cases, and pytest parametrize patterns, plus new community tools like Django Antipatterns and django-never-cache.
